title: Miscellanea
text:
Intuition comes in two— warm and cold.


The warm is joy, the heart’s own way. The cold is grammar, our common way.


Learning takes the cold in hand and kindles there a flame. Research lets the warm run wild and gives the flame a frame.


Talent is its voltage.


Frame into flame, flame into frame— round and round again.


Yet even a circle needs a first step.


Let mine be warm.
